# The modules, in one page

*Generated by `src/module_index.py` from each module's own first docstring line. Regenerate after adding a module; never hand-edit.*

## The corpus

- **catalogue_web** — Catalogues the roll's remaining sources from real wiki data
- **catalogue_aurora** — Catalogues the owner's homebrew sources directly from their Aurora Builder XML
- **catalogue_codex** — Catalogues the owner's own homebrew sources from THE_PRIME_OMNIVERSE_CODEX.md
- **wiki_source** — Resolves a roll source to a real wiki and pulls genuine entity data from it
- **feats** — FEATS — the evidence base for the Custodial Assay, mined from source text
- **sweep** — SWEEP — every character in the library, measured against every system built for them
- **read** — READ — the model reads the source pages; regex only decides what to skip
- **completeness** — COMPLETENESS — how much of each source's cast the library actually holds
- **hostcheck** — HOSTCHECK — does this wiki hold THIS fiction, or merely answer to the name?
- **hosts** — HOSTS — every site a source can be read from, not just the best one
- **scout** — SCOUT — find where a source's material lives, without a person doing the searching
- **endpoint** — ENDPOINT — how to read a wiki that is not Fandom, and not Wikipedia, and not cooperative
- **ingest_doc** — INGEST_DOC — an owner-supplied text becomes library corpus

## The instrument

- **assay** — The Custodial Assay — the calculation engine
- **magnitude** — MAGNITUDE — Charter Part Three's Custodial Assay, run against mined source text
- **anchors** — ANCHOR VALIDATION — the whole instrument, exercised at floor, standard and ceiling
- **scope** — SCOPE — the largest arena a fiction's conflicts are decided in, which is what bounds the Anchor
- **reference** — REFERENCE — hand-built Assays for three entities, to calibrate the automated pass against
- **rigor** — RIGOR — the commensuration engine, and the proof that the library's three rankings are one
- **identity** — IDENTITY — who a record is about, when an entity is more than one entity
- **chain** — CHAIN — phase 4, the Chain of Defeats. Who has beaten whom, and what that orders
- **weave_index** — Phase 3, first half — the global entity index and cross-source collision detector

## The phases and prose

- **pipeline** — Autonomous pipeline runner for the Panscriptum
- **generate** — Runs the generation manifest against a local Ollama model, compresses the output, and
- **manifest_builder** — Builds the generation job queue (manifest) from data/SWEEP_ROLL.json + data/records/*.json,
- **compress_store** — Compression + content-addressed storage for generated chapters
- **address** — Addressing for the Panscriptum, aligned to the REAL system defined in
- **catalog** — Query what's been generated so far
- **retry_synthesis** — RETRY the sources whose synthesis failed, WITHOUT touching anything the running pipeline owns
- **tells** — TELLS — the phrasings that mark text as machine-written, in one place
- **style_audit** — STYLE AUDIT — catch repetition across chapters, which no single chapter can see
- **pick_model** — Picks the best available local Ollama model for long-form, fact-grounded encyclopedia prose --

## The supervision stack

- **overnight** — OVERNIGHT — an unattended supervisor that runs the library's stages in the right order
- **autostart** — AUTOSTART — make the library survive a reboot, and make the supervisor survive its own death
- **foreman** — FOREMAN — reads the work orders and actually does something about them
- **standards** — STANDARDS — what "working" means, in numbers, and a work order when it is not met
- **overwatch** — OVERWATCH — a standing debug sweep. Structure checked continuously, code read by the model
- **allsweep** — ALLSWEEP — run every check this project owns, at once, and reconcile what they say
- **verify_math** — Independent verification of every number this project computes
- **health** — HEALTH — make failures loud, because every bug in this project has been a quiet one
- **silence** — SILENCE — the audit for this project's one recurring defect, and the discipline that ends it
- **estate** — ESTATE — everything this project owns that is not code, checked
- **dashboard** — DASHBOARD — what every meter in this project reads, on one page, without asking anybody
- **coverage** — COVERAGE — does every source, and everything inside it, carry a citation?
- **tuning** — TUNING — the settings that should never have been constants
- **lognames** — LOGNAMES — the one place a job's log file is named

## Transport

- **cascade_bridge** — CASCADE BRIDGE — route the library's model calls through the owner's quota-aware router

## Publishing

- **publish** — PUBLISH — the project and its instrument panel, on GitHub, without opening this machine to anyone
- **build_terminal** — Assemble the Registry Terminal: the omniverse as an atom, in one self-contained page

- **pantheon** — PANTHEON -- the divine tier of Universes 6 and 7, hand-built under the presence thesis
- **physics** — PHYSICS — the real-world quantities the Assay converts fiction into, and where they come from
- **profile** — THE WORLD PROFILE — one string that says everything, and from which everything regenerates
- **propagation** — INFORMATION PROPAGATION — how long it takes the omniverse to learn a thing
- **recover_folder_records** — Rebuilds the missing folder-mode records from data the cloud session already gathered
- **render** — RENDER — one dispatcher, nine tiers, from a burg to a hyperverse
- **repass_bands** — RE-PASS — re-apply the corrected evidence gate to everything already catalogued
- **resonance** — RESONANCE — the relational ontology, made computable
- **resync_roll** — Rebuilds SWEEP_ROLL.json's entry_count/status from the record files on disk
- **rosetta** — ROSETTA — each fiction's own power scale, mined and used as ground truth
- **runguard** — RUNGUARD — the overlap guard for the maintenance pass, as code instead of as a convention
- **scale_theories** — THE SCALE-CHANGE THEORIES — what would have to be true, and what it would cost
- **sevenfold** — THE SEVENFOLD ORDER — seven hyperverses, and a span of one to seven at every tier beneath
- **tempus** — DE TEMPORE — time across the omniverse, and what "now" can possibly mean
- **thread_integrity** — THREAD INTEGRITY — does the omniverse hold together when you walk it?
- **tiers** — THE COSMOLOGICAL TIERS — the xenoverse charted, and the hyperverse declined with cause
- **weave** — PHASE 3 — THE WEAVE. Cross-source entity resolution, with homonymy as the default
- **wh40k** — WARHAMMER 40,000 — the top of the setting, assayed under the presence thesis
- **worldseed** — WORLDSEED — a compact address that regenerates an inhabited world, derived from its catalogue entry
- **zfighters** — Z FIGHTERS -- hand-built assays under the presence thesis
